_usage: Set MOONCAKE_EXTERNAL_STORE_CONFIG to this file. Only direct, pre-registered buffers are supported. put/put_batch/put_parts and stage_nonlocal are unsupported; use FileStorage for internal staging.
_prototype: One Slice per key; original key is not parsed; offset=0. SDK config should set maxErrorCount=1. An uncertain Store failure stops the SDK; shutdown-barrier failure is fail-stop. Read fallback is not implemented.
